text:
frank: Customer reported a connector returned model-validated output but our schema gate rejected it and routed to degen. They were billed and confused.

anya: Do we have the raw payload? Which connector/model?

frank: model=open-sim-3, connector=zendesk-create. Payload snippet: `{"type":"ticket","body":["User report","Details"]}` — `body` is array, schema expects object `{subject, description}`.

morgan: Router treats schema mismatch as hard fail today. That triggers fallback path and billing for both attempts.

dev-bot: :warning: validation.observe spikes on prod-east-1 (3m)

olivia: Proposal: two-step rollout. 1) observe mode (header `x-validate-mode: observe`) to record validation outcomes without altering routing; 2) optional conservative coercion hook at adapter level that only converts positional arrays to objects when mapping is exact and reversible.

anya: Console should show a short redacted reason per request ("schema mismatch: body expected object, got array") behind an org-level toggle default off. Must not leak payloads unless explicitly consented.

morgan: Metrics plan: emit `validation.mismatch_total{route,model,env}` and `validation.coercion_applied_total`. Start with 1% sampling then ramp.

frank: Action items: morgan to add metrics + sampling, olivia to prototype adapter coercion with reversible diffs, anya to draft Console toggle and privacy blurb. Sync in 45m.
